title: NOBITA'S FINAL FANTASY - THE DORAEMON FF FANGAME THAT NEVER LEFT JAPAN

posts.author: PaulganPlats
posts.body:
My guess is that this game must be made by the same creator behind Nobita Senki ACE and Nobihaza.
But this time, this is a crossover between Doraemon and Final Fantasy.
It was made in around 2011-2012 using RPG Maker 2003
The prologue is when Nobita and friends intend to use the Time Machine to prove if Nobita lied, but instead, they fell into the warp and landed in an Earth-like realm called Gaia.
There, they have to survive in the world of Final Fantasy.
The first boss is Scarmiglione from FFIV
As the party progresses, they explore the worlds of three 16-bit Final Fantasy entries (FFIV, FFV, FFVI)
Unfortunately, Doraemon is killed off by Exdeath in this game, similar to Galuf's fate in the original FFV.
Then, the party continue without Doraemon and reached the final boss
The epilogue is, however, somewhat hopeful but strange at the same time; Dorami informs Nobita and Shizuka about Doraemon still alive
- THE SCREEN SHOWS DORAEMON DRIFTING IN THE VOID, POSSIBLY DEEP SPACE
So I am thinking of making an English translation of this obscure fangame. Any help if interested?
